title: CDSCO State Drug Alert: 132 Drug Batches Including Telmisartan, Azithromycin Fail Quality Tests
summary: New Delhi: In another major drug quality surveillance exercise, 132 batches of drugs, cosmetics and Ayurvedic products have been declared Not of Standard Quality (NSQ) by State Drug Testing...
